scope: Conventional single-phase CCM boost PFC alternatives around the maintained IPW65R045C7/UCC27624 experiment-02 baseline. No delivered-output or assembly-efficiency claim.

requested_input_power_w.basis: experiment-02 120 Vrms / 15 Arms input anchor; input ceiling, not pan/DC output

lowline_derating.value: At 108 Vrms, 15 Arms can supply at most 1620 W ideal-PF input; the 1796.310032 W anchor needs 16.633 Arms and is infeasible.

c7_partial_loss_model.basis: experiment-02 IPW65R045C7 no-assist overlap 37.3682 W + Eoss 1.5106 W + gate 0.1441 W scale with fsw; conduction 6.4795 W held constant at matched ripple

frequency_cases.frequency_status: inside UCC28180 18-250 kHz programmable range; 65 kHz is a source-check case

magnetics.source: Wurth 760800301 datasheet, local retained PDF SHA-256 4b01fecaf517331dbc40cc291b2b0841904d8a221228b43541c72416c91217f8
magnetics.fit_assessment: Exact 180 uH baseline candidate. Its 24.5 A rating is a thermal RMS rating; the maintained model's inductor RMS is the 15.0 A true-RMS input current. An ideal CCM conservative peak bound is about 23.365 A at that 15 A point, below the 43 A typical saturation-current screen. Installed airflow and hot-bias inductance still require proof.

core_loss_at_65_90_129_khz.required: vendor Steinmetz/B-H data or measured loss at bias and ripple

magnetics.warning: Scaling L inversely with frequency preserves ripple only if the new inductor reaches the stated effective L at operating current; fixed 180 uH at lower fsw increases ripple and changes peak/RMS/current stress.

silicon_switch_alternatives.status: baseline; actual Eon/Eoff and hot Rds in this loop remain unknown

silicon_switch_alternatives.technology: 650 V silicon CoolMOS CFD7 superjunction with fast body diode
silicon_switch_alternatives.source: Infineon Rev 2.1 datasheet, retained source manifest
silicon_switch_alternatives.directional_screen: Lower hot Rds typical but higher Qg/Eoss than C7; cannot call it lower total PFC loss without matched Eon/Eoff and thermal data.
silicon_switch_alternatives.status: conditional candidate; same TO-247-3 class, no Kelvin source

silicon_switch_alternatives.directional_screen: Control device in experiment-02; substantially higher modeled switching loss than C7 under the same gate profile.

bridge.basis: GBJ2510 estimated 1.05 V constant drop in maintained report; actual Vf-vs-current-temperature curve and thermal path missing

boost_diode.baseline: C3D20065D SiC; zero reverse-recovery in model is not a measured loss
boost_diode.silicon_alternative: requires exact ultrafast diode Qrr/forward curve; Qrr*Vbus*fsw grows with frequency and can erase lower-switching-loss benefit

shunt.basis: 10 mOhm nominal times 15 Arms squared; active shunt-repair candidate HCSM2818FT10L0 is 5 W conditional package rating, while historical WSL2726 was 3 W. Assembly thermal derating remains open

bulk_capacitor_esr.basis: frequency-dependent ESR/current sharing and 120 Hz ripple not closed

aux_and_controller.basis: supply producer, driver quiescent loss, controller loss and startup sequencing not implemented

heatsink_and_size_cost.basis: magnetic volume, airflow, thermal interface and procurement quotes absent; do not rank by fabricated cost

cheap_15v_control.proposal: Power UCC27624 from the actual AUX_15V rail instead of adding a separate nominal 12 V rail, if the rail is regulated at the driver pins and gate overshoot is bounded.
cheap_15v_control.why_plausible: UCC27624 recommended VDD spans 4.5-26 V; C7 VGS absolute maximum is +/-20 V; 15 V is compatible in principle.

energy_screen.warning: Qg*V*f is supply charge energy, not MOSFET switching loss; driver static and rail losses remain unknown. Qg is held fixed from a different bias test point; these are charge-scale estimates, not matched 15 V gate-drive predictions.
